section.11: The Rites of Hajj (Kitab Al-Manasik Wa'l-Hajj)

11.name_native: The Rites of Hajj (Kitab Al-Manasik Wa'l-Hajj)

hadiths.text: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:The people used to go out (from Mecca after Hajj) by all sides. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: No one should leave (Mecca) until he performs the last circumambulation of the House (the Ka'bah)
